description: React + Vite frontend: app bootstrap, packages/ui design system, packages/api-client, and all Phase 1 pages (auth, app shell, dashboard, users/roles, institution, departments, employees). Depends on FEAT-001 (shared packages, tsconfig bases). Can begin in parallel with FEAT-003 for the scaffold/design-system steps, but the page components that call APIs require FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 to be complete and running. Implemented sequentially here.
steps: Create apps/web/package.json: name @rims/web, scripts (dev: vite --port 5173, build: tsc && vite build, preview, lint, type-check: tsc --noEmit, test: vitest run, test:watch: vitest). dependencies: @rims/shared-types workspace:*, @rims/validation workspace:*, @rims/api-client workspace:*, @rims/ui workspace:*, react@19.0.0, react-dom@19.0.0, react-router-dom@6.28.0, @tanstack/react-query@5.62.7, @tanstack/react-query-devtools@5.62.7, zustand@5.0.2, react-hook-form@7.54.1, @hookform/resolvers@3.9.1, zod@3.23.8, axios@1.7.7, clsx@2.1.1, lucide-react@0.468.0. devDependencies: @vitejs/plugin-react@4.3.4, @tailwindcss/vite@4.0.0, tailwindcss@4.0.0, typescript@5.7.2, @types/react@19, @types/react-dom@19, vitest@2.1.8, @testing-library/react@16, @testing-library/user-event@14, jsdom@25.

Create apps/web/tsconfig.json (extends ../../packages/config/tsconfig.vite.json, jsx: react-jsx, paths: @rims/* mappings). Create apps/web/vite.config.ts: plugins [react(), tailwindcss()], server {port: 5173, proxy: {'/api': 'http://localhost:3000'}}, resolve.alias {@rims/shared-types, @rims/validation, @rims/api-client, @rims/ui}. Create apps/web/index.html. Create apps/web/tailwind.config.ts: extends with RIMS color palette (primary: #1E40AF blue scale, navy: #1E3A5F, accent teal/emerald). Create apps/web/src/main.tsx: QueryClientProvider + RouterProvider + React.StrictMode.

Create packages/ui/: package.json (@rims/ui, peer deps react+react-dom+tailwindcss), tsconfig.json, tailwind.config.ts (same palette extension). Components: src/components/Button.tsx (variants: primary/secondary/ghost/danger, sizes: sm/md/lg, loading state, aria-disabled, focus-visible ring), Input.tsx (label, error message, aria-describedby), Select.tsx, Textarea.tsx, Badge.tsx (variants: active=green-100 text-green-800, suspended=amber-100 text-amber-800, inactive/archived=grey-100 text-grey-600, pending=blue-100 text-blue-800), Modal.tsx (@radix-ui/react-dialog, focus trap, accessible close button, backdrop), Toast.tsx (@radix-ui/react-toast, auto-dismiss 5s, severity variants), DataTable.tsx (sortable columns via column def array, row selection, pagination controls), Spinner.tsx, Skeleton.tsx (animated shimmer), Card.tsx, EmptyState.tsx (icon+title+description+optional CTA). src/index.ts re-exports all. Add @radix-ui/react-dialog@1.1.2, @radix-ui/react-toast@1.2.2 to packages/ui/package.json.

Create packages/api-client/: package.json (@rims/api-client, dep axios@1.7.7). src/client.ts: axios instance baseURL=import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL||'', interceptors: request attaches Authorization Bearer from auth store, response handles 401→call /auth/refresh→retry original request, 403→redirect to /forbidden. src/endpoints/auth.ts (login, logout, forgotPassword, resetPassword, acceptInvitation). src/endpoints/users.ts (getMe, listUsers, inviteUser, updateUser). src/endpoints/roles.ts (listRoles, listPermissions, assignPermissions, assignRole). src/endpoints/tenant.ts (getCurrentTenant). src/endpoints/institution.ts (getInstitution, updateInstitution). src/endpoints/departments.ts (getDepartments, createDepartment, updateDepartment, archiveDepartment). src/endpoints/teams.ts (listTeams, createTeam, updateTeam, addMember). src/endpoints/employees.ts (listEmployees, createEmployee, getEmployee, updateEmployee). All functions typed with @rims/shared-types. src/index.ts re-exports all.

Create apps/web/src/store/auth.store.ts (Zustand): state {user: UserProfile|null, accessToken: string|null, permissions: string[]}; actions {setAuth(user, token, permissions), clearAuth()}. Persist accessToken to sessionStorage (not localStorage — shorter lived). Create apps/web/src/lib/query-client.ts: QueryClient with defaultOptions {queries: {staleTime: 30_000, retry: 1}, mutations: {retry: 0}}.

Create apps/web/src/router.tsx: createBrowserRouter with lazy routes. Routes: / → StatusPage, /login → AuthLayout+LoginPage, /forgot-password → ForgotPasswordPage, /reset-password/:token → ResetPasswordPage, /accept-invitation/:token → AcceptInvitationPage. Protected routes (wrapped in PrivateRoute): /dashboard → DashboardPage, /users → UsersPage, /users/:id → UserDetailPage, /roles → RolesPage, /roles/:id → RoleDetailPage, /institution → InstitutionPage, /departments → DepartmentsPage, /teams → TeamsPage, /employees → EmployeesPage, /employees/:id → EmployeeDetailPage, /audit → AuditPage. All page imports use React.lazy().

Create auth pages: apps/web/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx — form with email+password (React Hook Form + loginSchema from @rims/validation), calls apiClient.auth.login, on success: setAuth + navigate('/dashboard'). Show API error inline under form. RIMS wordmark (text logo) in header, 'A ProgrammoCeuticals Product' in footer. ForgotPasswordPage.tsx — email input, submit, success message. ResetPasswordPage.tsx — new password + confirm, Zod refinement for match. AcceptInvitationPage.tsx — first name + last name + password + confirm.

Create apps/web/src/layouts/AppShell.tsx: full implementation with Sidebar (module nav filtered by user permissions), Topbar (RIMS wordmark left, tenant name center, user avatar+dropdown right), Breadcrumbs (path-based using useLocation), main content area with Outlet. Sidebar collapse toggle (mobile hamburger, desktop mini-mode). Sidebar items: Dashboard (always visible), Users & Roles (users.view), Institution (institution.view), Departments (departments.view), Teams (teams.view), Employees (employees.view), Audit Log (audit.view). Permission check reads from auth store. Create apps/web/src/components/common/PrivateRoute.tsx: if !accessToken redirect to /login preserving intended path.

Create apps/web/src/pages/StatusPage.tsx: calls GET /api/v1/health, shows API status badge (green/red), uptime. Create apps/web/src/pages/dashboard/DashboardPage.tsx: 4 TanStack Query hooks (getMe for user info, listUsers for total count, getDepartments for active count, listAuditEvents for recent activity). KpiCard components with Skeleton while loading, EmptyState for zero-state. RecentActivity widget shows last 5 audit events.

Create apps/web/src/pages/users/UsersPage.tsx: DataTable with columns [name, email, status Badge, department, roles]. FilterBar: status Select, department Select (populated from getDepartments query), search Input. Pagination controls. InviteUserModal.tsx: React Hook Form + inviteUserSchema, role Select, department Select, email Input; submit calls apiClient.users.inviteUser; on success: invalidate users query + show Toast. UserDetailPage.tsx: user profile display + status action buttons (Suspend/Activate/Deactivate) each with confirmation Modal. PATCH calls updateUser.

Create apps/web/src/pages/roles/RolesPage.tsx: table of roles with description. RoleDetailPage.tsx: role name+description display, list all permissions grouped by module, each with a checkbox showing current assignment; Save button calls apiClient.roles.assignPermissions with full updated permission list.

Create apps/web/src/pages/institution/InstitutionPage.tsx: pre-populated form (useQuery getInstitution), React Hook Form + updateInstitutionSchema. Submit calls updateInstitution, shows success Toast. If user lacks institution.update permission, render form fields as read-only.

Create apps/web/src/pages/departments/DepartmentsPage.tsx: toggle view (tree | list). DepartmentTree.tsx: recursive component rendering nested departments with expand/collapse. CreateEditDepartmentModal.tsx: name Input + parent Select (all departments). Archive button + confirmation Modal. apps/web/src/pages/teams/TeamsPage.tsx: DataTable + create modal.

Create apps/web/src/pages/employees/EmployeesPage.tsx: DataTable with department filter + status filter + search + pagination. CreateEmployeeForm.tsx (slide-over panel): firstName, lastName, email, departmentId Select, positionId Select, hireDate Input. EmployeeDetailPage.tsx: profile card, employment records list, qualifications list, link-to-user account section.

Create apps/web/src/pages/audit/AuditPage.tsx: DataTable for audit events, paginated, filter by resourceType + dateRange. Read-only. RequirePermissions audit.view (redirect or show empty state if lacking).

Write Vitest tests: auth form validation (LoginPage — invalid email shows error, missing password shows error), DataTable renders rows from mock data, Badge renders correct color class per status variant. All in apps/web/src/**/*.test.tsx.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm --filter @rims/web test exits 0 with all Vitest tests passing
pnpm --filter @rims/web dev starts on port 5173 without errors
Navigating to http://localhost:5173/login renders the login form with RIMS wordmark and ProgrammoCeuticals footer
Logging in with seeded demo credentials (admin@rims.dev) redirects to /dashboard showing KPI cards
Sidebar shows only permitted navigation items based on user roles
Users list page renders DataTable with pagination and invite modal opens
Departments page renders tree view of sample departments
